scenes.stage_direction: Private memories interrupt the investigation. David listens without competing with either man from Amara's past.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He knew details of the service stair that were never made public.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He also said the family paid for the car.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We have his words. Now we test that claim against the payment.

metadata.evidence_summary: His knowledge corroborates the ransom evidence.
